title: QUT ePrints OAI-PMH Metadata Format
description: One metadataFormat entry from the QUT ePrints ListMetadataFormats response. The enum is closed to the four prefixes this repository actually advertises, read from the live response at https://eprints.qut.edu.au/cgi/oai2?verb=ListMetadataFormats (HTTP 200, 2026-09-01), archived at examples/qut-eprints-oai-listmetadataformats.xml.

metadataPrefix.description: oai_dc is Dublin Core; oai_openaire is the OpenAIRE guidelines profile; uketd_dc is the UK Electronic Theses and Dissertations profile; oai_bibl is an EPrints bibliographic profile.
